描述_EN: decor composed of a female bust in a central medallion inscribed in a square. fragmentary polychrome tapestry square. the second frame is formed of several red bands, the outermost of which is adorned with a frieze of posts. a frieze of plant elements and birds standing out against a green background frames the bust. The woman has very large, round eyes, blond (?) hair and a tiara with a central medallion. Fragments of a small two-tone red and green braid remain on the left side and complete the decoration.
描述_ZN: decor由一个女性半身像组成，中央的奖章镶嵌在一个正方形中。 fragmentary polychrome tapestry square. 第二个框架由几条红色带子组成，最外面的带子上有一个柱子的楣子装饰。 绿色背景下的植物和鸟类的门楣框住了半身像。 这个女人有一双非常大的圆眼睛，金色（？）的头发，戴着一个中央有奖章的头饰。 左手边留有红绿双色小辫子的碎片，完成了装饰。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期；伊斯兰统治时期
